name: Futami Ryouichi
source:
[i]"Either way, the people running this thing seem to be willing to grant wishes. So, it's different now that we know at least that."[/i]

A student in vocational school studying art. He's very good with his hands and loves to do silver crafting. He's the brother figure to the cast members who act selfishly. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch6]Idea Factory International[/url]]
